sonnet.problem: The card says Jerusalem is pictured as a young woman, the Virgin Daughter of Zion. It states what the picture stands for, but verse 22 does not say the Virgin Daughter of Zion is Jerusalem.
sonnet.rule: He retells the picture as the text gives it and says what it stands for only when the passage says so.

sonnet.problem: In "___ and reap", the wrong answers "fast" and "rest" do not fit the sentence. They are not believable, so the right answer stands out.
sonnet.rule: Clear English. Every card reads correctly. Each answer fits its question: in a blank, every answer matches the sentence's tense and form, and a "where" question gets places.

sonnet.problem: "The LORD isn't only talking about fields" adds a link between the sign and the people of Judah. Verses 30-31 do not say how the two connect.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: Cards 7 and 8 already told that Sennacherib will not attack Jerusalem and will go back the way he came (37:33-34). This card asks about the same fact again, and its answer is already given.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact.
